about: Talking-voice targets for spoken scripts, from the founder's chat lines and the agent replies he accepted (docs/voice/profile.md). Defaults used with judgement: every miss is a warning.

sentence_length_mean.hint: talk runs 14 to 15 words a sentence on average; split the longest ones or join the shortest

sentence_length_spread.hint: speech mixes short and long sentences; vary them

written_only_per1000.hint: swap thus, therefore, subsequently, in order to for so, then, to

latinate_share.hint: prefer short everyday words to -tion, -ity, -ment words

connectives_per100.hint: join the steps with and, so, because, but, then

long_chain_share.hint: a sentence over 30 words with 3 or more connectives runs on; break it where the topic turns

questions_per100_sentences.hint: ask the question the listener would ask, then answer it

i_we_per100.hint: say what you did, saw or think

then_share_of_step_words.hint: say then again instead of next, after that, subsequently

referent_rotation.hint: pick one name for the thing (the model) and repeat it
